hooks.command: [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/gloss" ] && PATH="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:$PATH"; GLOSS_ACTOR=agent:claude-code gloss hook guard --event pre-edit 2>/dev/null || true
[ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/gloss" ] && PATH="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:$PATH"; GLOSS_ACTOR=agent:claude-code gloss hook guard --event post-edit 2>/dev/null || true
[ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/gloss" ] && PATH="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:$PATH"; GLOSS_ACTOR=agent:claude-code gloss hook guard --event stop

grep -q '"stop_hook_active": *true' && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; f=$(gofmt -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^\.claude/'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "gofmt: not formatted:" $f "- run gofmt -w on these files before you finish." >&2; exit 2
